title: Single-Flight Cache for Concurrent Callers
instructions: Implement `SingleFlightCache` in `singleflight.py`: a thread-safe memoizer where concurrent callers for the same key share one computation, different keys compute in parallel, and `compute` runs outside the lock. Hand results to waiters through a `Future`, propagate exceptions to all of them without caching, and support `invalidate` and `len`.

evidence.label: Eight simultaneous callers for one key trigger exactly one computation
Different keys compute at the same time (compute runs outside the lock)
All waiters get the leader's exception, nothing is cached and a later call retries
invalidate() forces the next get to recompute
A failed computation leaves no cached value and the next call retries
len counts cached keys; invalidating an unknown key is harmless
